Leah (CSM): FYI CitrusBank dropped ~74% in token volume overnight. Their ML lead mentioned a short trial with ZephyrML in an email thread. Need renewal-risk triage. :warning:
redwood-bot: [alert] account_usage_drop: CitrusBank (acct_6310) - 74% WoW. AlertID: UDF-6310-04
Owen (AE): yikes. Who's the champion now? any procurement signals or timeline?
Leah (CSM): Champion is Marco (ML). He said they hit "throughput regressions" after our last config change and are running a 2-week ZephyrML eval starting 2025-12-02. No formal RFP yet.
Nikhil (SE): Telemetry snippet (tokens/day):
2025-11-26: 54,200
2025-11-27: 52,900
2025-11-28: 14,800
2025-11-29: 9,700
2025-11-30: 6,300
2025-12-01: 3,100

Priyanka (CS Ops): Quick playbook: 1) 20m triage check today to surface infra vs model causes; 2) offer controlled 72h env-parity bench where we host our variant; 3) share regression on their golden prompts + short SLO/cost note. I'll try to book.
Owen (AE): Commercial ask: propose a small "env-parity" credit (covers infra for the bench) and NDA-lite to exchange minimal eval data. Also get Zephyr success metrics on the call.
Nikhil (SE): Prep plan: reproduce failing route, pin quant variant q4_8bit, enable prefix KV caching, and set batch_target=3 for latency-sensitive endpoints. Snippet to toggle: ```PATCH /v1/accounts/6310/config { "prefix_cache": true, "quant_variant": "q4_8bit", "batch_target": 3 }```
Leah (CSM): Action items: Owen - lead outreach and ask for Zephyr success metrics; Nikhil - short repro & one-pager on expected perf gains before call; Priyanka - book 20m and attach telemetry + repro; Leah - prepare renewal-risk summary for AM and mark for exec-escalation if they indicate replacement.
Priyanka (CS Ops): Booked 20m with Marco for 2025-12-02 09:30 PT. Agenda: usage trend, Zephyr pilot scope, env-parity offer, quick demo of cache/quant wins. Invite includes telemetry + repro link.
Owen (AE): On the call I'll ask for permission to run a constrained A/B (we host our variant) for 72h and request written success criteria. If they can't do that, push for same-hardware runs or detailed metrics.
Nikhil (SE): Quick perf note I'll share: enabling prefix cache + pinned q4_8bit typically cuts p50 on retrieval-heavy paths ~150ms -> ~80ms in our benchmarks. One-pager uploading now.
redwood-bot: [note] alert acknowledged by Leah at 2025-12-01T14:08:05Z
Leah (CSM): If they confirm competitor parity testing, escalate to Director CS for a QBR within 5 business days. Case# CS-6310-ENVPAR. Keep thread replies short for handoff.
Owen (AE): :thumbsup: will update after the 12/02 check-in.
